extraction.Name: Luther Arcoran
extraction.NOTES: Source: split from multi-allottee bundle (part3_agency_narrative_007.json) on 2026-05-03 using Sonnet vision extraction. Allotment 1196. Patent date: 1920-03-12. Patent number: 739691. Mechanism: administrative. Buyer: Edward L. McHenry. Sale price: $12,000. Land conveyed to Edward L. McHenry for $12,000 — same buyer named in part 4 records (McHenry as recurring Rosebud allotment purchaser). Tripp County sheriff levied on this allotment. Note: this record duplicates content also captured at part4_agency_narrative_008 (also Luther Arcoran 1196). Cross-reference both records for full case detail. Sibling record (other allottee in original bundle): part3_agency_narrative_007b.json. Vision extraction archived at: validation_samples/part3_agency_narrative_007_vision/vision_merged.json.
